model: NES Classic Edition / Nintendo Classic Mini: Nintendo Entertainment System

sources.quote: The classic NES is back in a familiar-yet-new form as a mini replica of Nintendo’s original home console.
the console comes complete with 30 NES games built-in
POWER / RESET / If you press RESET while playing the game, the game is saved and the system returns to the HOME Menu.

notes: Nintendo of Europe 'Nintendo History' page for the Nintendo Classic Mini: Nintendo Entertainment System (EU) and Nintendo of America's NES Classic Edition start-up instructions (archived copy of nintendo.com/consumer/downloads/manual-start-up-instructions-nes-classic-edition.pdf, print code MAA-CLV-S-NESA-USZ-C0, © 2016; born-digital text via pypdf). Model CLV-001 per the Wikidata item and support pages; not printed in either quote, so model_numbers is omitted.

No Nintendo page or document read prints dimensions or mass for the Western NES Classic; body null. Retail and wiki figures found by search disagree and are secondary (not used). The Japanese Famicom mini (ニンテンドークラシックミニ ファミリーコンピュータ) is a different shell; Nintendo JP's release says it is about 60 % of the Famicom's size, not a dimension.
media: games are built in ('30 NES games built-in') → a covered empty media list (no cartridge slot).

controls: the start-up sheet labels POWER and RESET on the console; it says 'press the power switch OFF and then ON again' in English while the Spanish column calls it 'Botón de encendido', so the form is ambiguous → filed as power_switch (the English wording) with this flag, and reset_button.
ports: the sheet shows the controller connector, an HDMI cable and a USB power cable but gives no list or counts for the console's own sockets; ports stay uncovered.
role 'mini'. external_ids: Wikidata Q26706777 ('NES Classic Edition'); no P5795 on it, igdb_platform null.
